entries.claim: The exact pinned direct Latin Mass body at line 171 corroborates the complete 100-word lesson as a derived digital witness; no inherited reference or expansion supplies it.

The complete 100-word lesson has been checked directly on the Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam pages, printed pp. 466–467, leaves n547–n548: it begins at the foot of p. 466 and ends at the top of p. 467. This states current conformity, not original transcription genesis.
